SUBJECT: Preparatory Office of the Shanghai Special Municipality Confectionary Shop Employees' Union - members assaulted.
The Shanghai Special Municipality Confectionary Shop Employees' Union (上海茶食業職工會), was inaugurated in August, 1940, with an office at House No.37, Si Lin Heng Road (西林橫路), Nantao. Tsang Tse Kao (張志高) and Loo Ping Sung (羅炳生) and three others were standing committee members of the Union. Following the formation of the Shanghai Municipality Labour Unions Readjustment Committee, Lane 247/5 Chung Hwa Road, Nantao, the Shanghai Special Municipality Confectionary Shop Employees' Union was taken over by the Shanghai Branch, Social Movement Direction Committee at the beginning of June, 1941. The Union was formerly connected with the now defunct Nantao General Labour Union. All the documents, chops, etc., pertaining to the Confectionary Union, were taken away, prior to the taking over, by Tsang Tse Kao and Loo Ping Sung. The Union was later re-named by the Shanghai Branch, Social Movement Direction Committee, the "Preparatory Office of the Shanghai Special Municipality Confectionary and Candy Shop Employees' Union (上海特別市茶食糖果業職業工會籌備會)." SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

........................................Station. File No. .................... Date ....................................

SUBJECT: ( 2 )

issued in the name of the Preparatory Office of
the Shanghai Special Municipality Confectionary
and Candy Shop Employees' Union. The Preparatory
Office of the Union has now commenced free registra-
tion of members which will conclude at the end of
June, 1941.

At 4 p.m. on June 22, 1941, some 7 persons
of the workers' type, attended the Preparatory
Office of the Union and asked to register with
the Union. They were interviewed by Deputy-Chief,
Zang Ying Sing and Clerk Sung Shih Faung, the latter
were suddenly assaulted and slightly injured by the
intruders who made good their escape after causing
damage to some furniture on the premises. A report
was made to the Shanghai Branch, Social Movement
Direction Committee by the Preparatory Office of the
Union, stating that the incident was instigated by
Tsang Tse Kao and Loo Ping Sung, the former standing
Committee members of the defunct Shanghai Municipality
Confectionary Shop Employees' Union.

上海特别市茶食糖果业职业工会筹备会的名义签发。该工会筹备会现已开始免费办理会员登记，将于1941年6月底结束。

1941年6月22日下午4时，约7名工人模样的人来到工会筹备会，要求登记加入工会。他们由副主任陈铭新（Zang Ying Sing，注：此处原文拼写与上文Zung King Sing略有不同，依上下文应为同一人，即陈铭新）和干事孙世芳接待，后者突然遭到闯入者袭击并受轻伤，闯入者在损坏了现场的一些家具后逃逸。工会筹备会向社会运动指导委员会上海分会提交了一份报告，称此次事件是由已解散的上海特别市茶食业职业工会前常务委员张志高和罗炳生煽动的。

June 24, 1941. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News, Kuo Min Daily News, New China Daily
News and Bing-Pao :-

THE CONFECTIONERY AND CANDY SHOP WORKERS' UNION.

After Chang Liu (張鎔), Chen
Ming-sing (陳銘新) and others took over the
Shanghai Confectionery and Candy Shop Workers' Union,
they began to make preparations for the reorganization
of the union. Chang Liu was elected Chairman with
Chen Ming-sing as Vice-Chairman of a Preparatory Committee
with an office at No. 37 Si Lin Heng Road (西林橫路),
Nantao.

At the time that Chang and Liu took
over the union, Chang Chi-kao (張志高), the former
Chairman of the union, Loo Ping-sun (羅炳生) and
others refused to hand over the list of names of
members and the account books. Of late, Chang Chi-kao
and the others have been holding secret meetings with
the managements of confectionery and candy shops in an
attempt to obstruct the work of the union. It is
said that the union has been re-registered with the
Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction
Committee.

At 4 p.m. June 22, Chang Chi-kao
and the others together with about 20 loafers armed
with iron and wooden bars entered the union's office
pretending to join the union; Chen Ming-sing, Sung
Shih-fang (孫世芳), secretary of the union, and
others who were in the office were badly beaten up by
the callers who also smashed up the desks and other
furniture. Chen Ming-sing, Sung Shih-fang and several
other injured men later went to a hospital for treatment.
The union has made a report of the
occurrence to the Police authorities concerned and to
the Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction
Committee.

1941年6月24日。晨间译报。

《华中日报》、《国民日报》、《新中国日报》及《平报》：

茶食糖果业职业工会。

张鎔（Chang Liu）、陈铭新（Chen Ming-sing）等人接管上海茶食糖果业职业工会后，开始着手改组工会的准备工作。张鎔当选为筹备委员会主任，陈铭新任副主任，办事处设在南市西林横路37号。

在张、刘接管工会时，原工会主席张志高（Chang Chi-kao）、罗炳生（Loo Ping-sun）等人拒绝移交会员名单和账簿。近来，张志高等人一直与茶食糖果店的资方举行秘密会议，企图阻碍工会工作。据悉，该工会已在社会运动指导委员会上海分会重新注册。

6月22日下午4时，张志高等人伙同约20名手持铁棍和木棒的无业游民进入工会办事处，假装要加入工会；当时在办事处的陈铭新、工会秘书孙世芳（Sung Shih-fang）等人遭到来访者的毒打，桌椅和其他家具也被砸坏。陈铭新、孙世芳及其他几名受伤人员随后前往医院接受治疗。工会已就此事向有关警察当局和社会运动指导委员会上海分会作了报告。

June 24, 1941.
Morning Translation.

Cheng Yien Pao, National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News,
Sin Wan Pao and Shun Pao :-

COMMERCIAL PRESS TO RESUME BUSINESS SOON

The labour trouble in the Commercial
Press was settled through the mediation of Miss Hinder
of the S.M.C. Industrial Section. About 550 workers
have had their services terminated and the management
is paying them off.
The Commercial Press will resume
business on July 1.

Sin Shun Pao, Central China Daily News, Bing Pao, Kuo Min
Daily News, New China Daily News and Shanghai Press :-

EMPLOYEES OF MACHINE-MADE NOODLE CUTTING TRADE DEMAND
BETTER TREATMENT

Employees of the local machine-made
noodle cutting trade recently made a demand for better
trade. When their demand was rejected, they requested
the Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction
Committee to mediate.
It is learned that a mediation
meeting will be held on June 23 when representatives of
both parties will be present.

Cheng Yien Pao, National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News,
Sin Wan Pao and Shun Pao :-

ARREST OF THREE CHINESE BY JAPANESE IN FRENCH CONCESSION

At about 5 a.m. June 21, several
plain clothes Japanese accompanied by officers of the
French Police arrived at No. 6 Lane No. 100 Route
Paul Henry where a female chief tenant and a maid-
servant were arrested, but they were released on June 22.
No information is available as to the cause of their
arrest.
On June 21, a male Chinese of about
40 was arrested at No. 1 Rue Corneille and was taken to
Hongkew. The name of the arrested man is unknown.
F. T. C.

1941年6月24日。
晨间译报。

《正言报》、《国家导报》、《中美日报》、《新晚报》及《申报》：

商务印书馆即将复业

商务印书馆的劳资纠纷经工部局工业科欣德小姐（Miss Hinder）调解得以解决。约550名工人已被解雇，资方正在向他们支付遣散费。
商务印书馆将于7月1日复业。

《新顺报》、《华中日报》、《平报》、《国民日报》、《新中国日报》及《上海日报》：

机制切面业职工要求改善待遇

本地机制切面业职工近日提出要求改善行业待遇。在其要求被拒绝后，他们请求社会运动指导委员会上海分会进行调解。
据悉，双方代表将出席于6月23日举行的调解会议。

《正言报》、《国家导报》、《中美日报》、《新晚报》及《申报》：

法租界日本人逮捕三名华人

6月21日凌晨5时许，几名便衣日本人在法国警察的陪同下到达亨利路（Route Paul Henry）100弄6号，逮捕了一名女二房东和一名女佣，但她们于6月22日被释放。关于其被捕原因暂无消息。
6月21日，一名约40岁的华籍男子在高乃伊路（Rue Corneille）1号被捕，并被带往虹口。被捕者姓名不详。
F. T. C.

Labour Union" sent for Chang Lai Ding to attend
a meeting in Nantao with a view to discussing
a number of demands for better treatment.
Chang did not attend.    The demands have never
been submitted to the employers for consideration.
        Between 1 p.m. and 2 p.m. September 13,
some 20 members of the union called in a group at
four confectionery shops on Rue du Consulat and
compelled workers therein to strike and join the
union.    Nine arrests were made by the French
police.
        Fearing lest these union elements should
do likewise in the Settlement, the Chairman of the
Shanghai Confectionery Shop Owners' Association
wrote the attached letter and requested Police
protection.    During the interview, he was advised
to notify his members to inform the nearest police-
men should intimidation take place.
        This owners' association is not registered
with the Municipal Police.    Chang Lai Ding stated
that application for registration would be submitted
in due course.

工会”召张兰亭到南市参加会议，旨在讨论一系列改善待遇的要求。张未出席。这些要求从未提交给雇主考虑。
        9月13日下午1时至2时之间，约20名工会成员成群结队地来到领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）的四家茶食店，强迫店内工人罢工并加入工会。法国警察逮捕了九人。
        由于担心这些工会分子在租界内采取类似行动，上海茶食店业主公会主席写了附件中的信件，请求警方保护。在问询期间，建议他通知其会员，如果发生恐吓行为，应通知最近的警察。
        该业主公会未在工部局警务处注册。张兰亭表示，将在适当时候提交注册申请。
